title: Physicists have discovered what looks like an entire family of new particles in the LHC
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
http://www.sciencealert.com/physicists- ... in-the-lhc

Physicists have discovered what looks like an entire family of new particles in the LHC

They can’t be explained by our existing laws of physics.

Perhaps aliens have the answer? I love these kinds of articles that tell you "we found something we think but we don't what it is if it is really something". Then they write up papers on what it might be if it is - even give it names and colors and flavors. And we seem to learn nothing of any real value and the universe goes on being what it really is. Holding out hope that some day RS is made understandable because it sure beats these kind of stories!

A particle physics analogy would be to analyze the structure of an apple by loading it into a cannon, shooting it at a brick wall, then examining each bit of sauce stuck to the bricks.

What they found is the apple sauce... not the apple. Fragments of atomic rotating systems, randomly distributed. Nothing to do with fundamental apples of the universe.

Ask Gopi or anyone else involved with the High Priests of Physics... it is not about discovering anything, but making a name for yourself.
